title: From Alpha to Execution: Trading Horizons, Regimes, and Schedules under Concave Impact and Hurst Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.23749v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Classical execution models assume linear impact, diffusive prices, and an exogenous horizon. We study execution under concave power-law impact and Hurst-scaled price fluctuations, and make two contributions.   First, we choose the execution horizon by maximizing the Sharpe ratio of the trade's realized P&L. Price moves during the execution window are part of that P&L, so executing more slowly reduces its variance, and because impact is concave it can also lower cost per share. Urgency comes only from alpha realized while the order is being worked. The problem is governed by the signs of two quantities: (i) the duration elasticity of impact $a$, which under a structural prior equals the impact-persistence gap $\beta - H$ and can take either sign; and (ii) the net urgency $\nu$, the rate of alpha realization net of exposure relief. When $\nu$ keeps its sign over the window, an interior optimum exists, to leading order in $T/t_f$, only when

translated_title: 从Alpha到执行：凹性冲击与Hurst标度下的交易期限、状态与调度
translated_abstract: 经典的执行模型假设线性冲击、扩散性价格以及外生给定的执行期限。我们研究了在凹性幂律冲击和Hurst标度价格波动下的执行问题，并做出了两项贡献。首先，我们通过最大化交易已实现盈亏（P&L）的夏普比率来选择执行期限。执行窗口内的价格变动是该盈亏的一部分，因此执行得越慢，盈亏的方差越小，而且由于冲击具有凹性，较慢的执行还能降低每股成本。紧迫性仅来自于订单执行期间所实现的alpha。该问题由两个量的符号决定：(i) 冲击的期限弹性 $a$，在结构性先验假设下等于冲击持续性差距 $\beta - H$，且可正可负；(ii) 净紧迫性 $\nu$，即扣除风险敞口缓解效应后的alpha实现速率。当 $\nu$ 在整个窗口内保持符号不变时，在 $T/t_f$ 的主导阶近似下，内点最优解仅在……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文突破了经典执行模型线性冲击与外生期限的假设，提出通过最大化交易已实现盈亏的夏普比率来内生化执行期限的选择，并证明最优执行结构由冲击期限弹性（等于冲击持续性差距 β−H）与净紧迫性 ν 这两个量的符号共同决定。
en_tdlr: This paper endogenizes the choice of execution horizon by maximizing the Sharpe ratio of realized P&L under concave power-law impact and Hurst-scaled price fluctuations, showing that optimal execution is governed by the signs of the impact duration elasticity (equal to the impact-persistence gap β−H) and the net urgency ν.
